## Goal
- Fix only the failed IVX E2E Acceptance Pipeline run #569 checks, publish one corrective commit, rerun it, and verify TypeScript/lint gates unblock E2E jobs.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Use GitHub repository `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform` on `main`.
- Inspect exact GitHub Actions run #569 logs and annotations before fixing.
- Do not use `@ts-ignore`, broad `any` casts, disabled checks, `continue-on-error`, or `|| true` to hide failures.
- Verify `bun install --frozen-lockfile` for root and Expo.
- Run root TypeScript, Expo TypeScript, root lint, and Expo lint.
- Return only the requested status fields in the eventual user-facing response.
- Do not expose GitHub, Render, Supabase, or owner credential values.

## Progress
### Done
- Located the requested workflow run:
  - Workflow: `IVX E2E Acceptance Pipeline`
  - Run number: `569`
  - Run ID: `30727630249`
  - URL: `https://github.com/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform/actions/runs/30727630249`
  - Failed commit: `848f8e8541a0c4328149ffa8747ddfbfd543e5df`.
- Retrieved exact jobs and logs:
  - `TypeScript typecheck` job ID `91442672112`: failed at `Install deps (root + expo)`; both TypeScript commands were skipped.
  - `Lint` job ID `91442672127`: failed at dependency installation; lint command was not reached.
  - Playwright and Maestro were skipped because they `needs: [typecheck]`.
- Identified exact root cause from GitHub logs:
  - File/job log: `/tmp/ivx-run-569/TypeScript typecheck/4_Install deps (root + expo).txt`
  - Command: `bun install --frozen-lockfile`
  - CI Bun version: `bun install v1.3.14 (0d9b296a)`
  - Exact error: `error: lockfile had changes, but lockfile is frozen`
  - Follow-up: `note: try re-running without --frozen-lockfile and commit the updated lockfile`
  - Same frozen-lockfile failure occurred in Lint’s `bun install --frozen-lockfile --cwd expo`.
- Verified the committed lockfiles succeed under Bun `1.3.9`:
  - `bun install --frozen-lockfile` → passed.
  - `bun install --frozen-lockfile --cwd expo` → passed.
- Updated `.github/workflows/ivx-e2e.yml` to pin `oven-sh/setup-bun@v2` to `bun-version: 1.3.9` in both `typecheck` and `lint`, matching the verified lockfile-compatible Bun version.
- Removed failure-hiding controls from this workflow:
  - Changed `bun run --cwd expo lint || true` to `bun run --cwd expo lint`.
  - Removed `continue-on-error: true` from Playwright browser installation/test execution and Maestro installation/test execution.
- Diagnosed and fixed Expo TypeScript issues exposed locally:
  - `expo/app/(tabs)/aura.tsx`: made `fetchWithAuth<T>()` generic and typed `Promise.allSettled()` fetches to remove `unknown` settled values.
  - `expo/src/modules/ivx-owner-ai/services/ivxChatService.ts`: added `getLocalOwnerMessages` to exported `ivxChatService`.
  - `expo/app/ivx/rork-independence.tsx`: updated stale `rork*` property references to `external*` report properties.
  - `expo/app/knowledge-base.tsx`: changed invalid `backgroundColor` View prop to a style array.
  - `expo/app/knowledge-base/article/[articleId].tsx`: added missing `styles.headerTitle`.
  - `expo/src/modules/chat/chatScrollStateMachine.ts`: removed invalid access to non-existent `shouldResetConversationState`.
- Current local results:
  - `bun x tsc --noEmit` at root: passed.
  - `bun x tsc --noEmit` in `expo`: passed.
  - `bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun install --frozen-lockfile --cwd expo`: passed.
  - `bun run --cwd expo lint`: exits successfully with existing warnings.

### In Progress
- Complete root lint verification using the repository’s available root lint command/script.
- Review final working tree to ensure only corrective workflow/source files are included.
- Create one corrective GitHub commit, push to `main`, rerun/observe GitHub Actions, and record resulting job conclusions.

### Blocked
- `bun run lint` at repository root did not run a lint script; Bun displayed usage output, indicating root `package.json` may not define a `lint` script. Need identify the intended root lint command/workflow-equivalent without adding or disabling checks.
- No corrective commit has been created or pushed yet.
- No post-fix GitHub Actions run exists yet; Playwright and Maestro status cannot yet be confirmed.

## Key Decisions
- Treat run #569 as a lockfile/Bun-version compatibility failure, not an actual TypeScript or ESLint diagnostic failure: both validation commands were skipped in CI after installation failed.
- Pin Bun to `1.3.9` rather than mutate lockfiles, because both root and Expo frozen installs succeed locally with `1.3.9`, while GitHub’s prior `latest` resolved to `1.3.14` and rejected the frozen lockfiles.
- Keep frozen-lockfile enforcement enabled; do not bypass installation integrity.
- Remove existing `|| true` and `continue-on-error` controls in `.github/workflows/ivx-e2e.yml` so lint and E2E failures are observable rather than masked.
- Fix real Expo compiler issues directly without suppression directives or broad casts.

## Next Steps
1. Inspect root `package.json` scripts and workflow conventions to determine/run the intended root lint command.
2. Re-run all required local checks:
   - `bun install --frozen-lockfile`
   - `bun install --frozen-lockfile --cwd expo`
   - `bun x tsc --noEmit`
   - `cd expo && bun x tsc --noEmit`
   - root lint command
   - `bun run --cwd expo lint`
3. Review `git diff --check` and the exact changed file list.
4. Create exactly one corrective commit and push it to `main`.
5. Trigger or wait for the new `IVX E2E Acceptance Pipeline` run.
6. Confirm `TypeScript typecheck` and `Lint` are green and that Playwright/Maestro begin; report the resulting run URL and all requested statuses only.

- GitHub annotations only reported generic workflow-location failures:
  - TypeScript annotation: `.github`, line `12`, `Process completed with exit code 1.`
  - Lint annotation: `.github`, line `10`, `Process completed with exit code 1.`
- Existing GitHub release commits were published before this CI-focused task:
  - `848f8e8541a0c4328149ffa8747ddfbfd543e5df`
  - `f29eeaa51a22f32387fa2f2a4460124c9a0b9dc8`
  - `6943d9a23f5f45a2f5f7135b600adfc67e389ff5`

- Current local `HEAD` observed during this task:
  - `dda12dd31fc15f753921da3cc79091f7f280d7b4`
  - Subject: `New version from Rork`.
- Current working tree has uncommitted corrective changes in workflow and Expo source files.
- Do not include `.rork/history/main/` conversation artifacts or `data/enterprise-reports/` generated artifacts in a release commit.
